# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large bundle of call-recordings, but only a modest slice are genuine sales/enquiry calls — the rest are logistics/trailer-booking calls (Trans Raipur, Trans Nagpur, Trans Aarsan, Trans Tirupati), payment/collection follow-ups (Subhraa Metal, Swathika Bsc, Uniqcore), and MTC/document-chasing calls (Uniqcore Const Site Vinoth). The real sales material comes mainly from: SS Natarajan/Chandhrashekar (plate/coil cutting negotiations), Subhraa Metal (steel trader rate & stock calls), Sun Construction/Saveetha College (TMT rate enquiries for a construction buyer), Tirupati Balasubramaniam & Thirumala Steel Vizag (AP/Telugu-mixed dealer-to-dealer TMT rate haggling), Thangaraj Metfra (plate cutting/fabrication orders), V R Earth Movers (ISMB/channel rate negotiation), Vinayaga Steel Pradeep (plate stock/rate), Surya Raja/VLT Trading (channel dealer order + payment), and assorted one-off enquiries (Sumit Bhandari, Syed Rahamathulla, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah). Given the volume of non-sales noise, this KB is built strictly from the sales-relevant segments; conclusions should be read as indicative patterns, not a statistically large sample.

## Products & brand ladder
BSC sells **structural & flat steel**, not roofing sheets. Product lines actually discussed:
- **TMT rebar** (8–32 mm) — brands: **SAIL, Vizag/RINL, JSW, JSPL**, plus secondary brands **Suryadev/Suryoday** mentioned only as a lower-tier alternative customers ask about ("Suryoday for Polag... secondary brand... We are dealing primary make only, Sail and Vizag").
- **HR/MS Plates** (3–46 mm thickness; checker plates too) — standard coil widths 1250/1500 mm, standard lengths 2.5 m/5 m/6.3 m/12 m; grades mentioned: E250 BR, E350 BR/BO (rare), 250D/550D.
- **Channels, Angles, I-Beams/ISMB, NPB/NPP (joist) beams, RHS/SHS/CHS pipes** — mostly "sale-wise" (non-branded/secondary) stock; primary brand (Apollo, Tata) supplied only against specific customer request.
- **Flats, square tubes** — limited stock ("35 இல்லாம், 50-க்கு மேல தான் இருக்கும்").
- **Coils** (HR coil, cut-to-size service) — company does coil cutting but needs **minimum ~5–6 ton per width** to justify a cut.

Brand hierarchy signalled in calls: primary (SAIL/Vizag/Tata/JSW) > secondary (Suryadev etc., explicitly declined as "we deal primary only"). "Sale" (seconds/non-branded) is the default cheaper line sold against most structural enquiries unless the customer insists on a named primary brand.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- TMT 8 mm, Vizag: **₹70 + tax** (SSM Engineers call; Sun Construction call confirms similar "70+tax" for 20 mm Sail/CRS)
- TMT 16 mm conversion, Vizag, delivered: **₹645/ton converted basis** ("16 mm conversion VHP 645 delivery")
- TMT (Tirupati/AP dealer channel): 12–25 mm ≈ **₹65**, 10 mm **₹68**, 8 mm **₹69–71** (constantly renegotiated, moves ₹1–3/kg week to week)
- HR plate 6 mm: **₹64/kg**; a 2 m width variant adds **+₹1,500** over standard
- Checker plate full lot: **₹65,000** (incl.+GST separately, confirmed "+GST" by seller)
- HR sheet 250 BR grade, door delivery: **₹67,300/ton**, with a seller note "₹1,500 per ton increase expected next month (NMDC/SAIL hike)"
- ISMB 250 (primary, e.g. Apollo): **₹60,500–62,500/ton + GST + loading + transport**
- Plate (general) market band quoted multiple times: **₹61–64/kg**, moving up roughly **₹500–₹1,000/ton per week** in the observed period
- TMT 12/16 mm quote to Saveetha Institute: **₹69 (12 mm) / ₹68.5 (16 mm) + GST extra** ("GST extra extra")
- Coil-to-coil (full coil, customer takes scrap/end-bit) vs custom-cut: **coil-to-coil is ₹500/ton cheaper**
- Cutting charge: **₹500/ton** standard; size cutting needs **minimum ~1.5–6 ton** lot depending on item
- Channel 300×150 vs 300×140: price gap **₹3,000/ton** (weight/flange difference)
- Trailer/transport load limit: **40–42 ton practical max**; 46-ton loads "overload-ஆனதால்" cannot be moved from Chennai
- GST and loading/transport are **consistently quoted as extra**, never baked into material rate unless explicitly "door delivery"

## Objection Playbook
**1. "Rate ஜாஸ்தி இருக்கு" (price too high / competitor cheaper)**
- Customer: *"இன்னைக்கு 65 ஆரு பேற்றா அதே rate உண்டி"* (another dealer offered ₹65, match it) — seller holds firm citing demand: *"material இல்லை కాబట్టి அது rate அதிகம் పెట్టார்... demand இருக்கு"*.
- Response pattern: acknowledge the gap is small, explain it via input cost/demand-supply, offer a token reduction (₹100–₹500) rather than matching fully — seen in Uniqcore call: *"ஆனால் ₹100-200 கம்மி பண்ணுங்க சார் அவ்வளோதான் வேற என்ன பண்ண முடியும்"*.

**2. Small quantity can't get mill/owner rate**
- *"4 ton சின்ன quantity-ங்கிறீங்க"* — seller explains coil cutting only viable above ~5–6
